info.title: Tattva AI Film Director API
info.description: Tenant-scoped API for projects, assets, Script Intelligence workflows, human approval gates, canonical versions and audit trails.

get.description:
Liveness: this process is up and able to handle a request at all. No dependency
(not even the database) is checked -- a database outage must not make an
orchestrator restart a perfectly healthy API process.
Readiness: this instance can actually serve a real request right now.

system_managed.title: System Managed
system_managed.description: True when this group's 'validate' subpoint is completed automatically by a system check (completion_check.kind == 'system') rather than by hand -- the client hides the manual 'Mark complete' action for that subpoint.

ProductionMode.title: ProductionMode
ProductionMode.description:
Project/scene/(sequence/character/shot when those tables exist)-level mode
(D1, TFD-PRJ-003/004; PRD §2.2 inheritance: ``effective_mode(x) = x.mode ?? parent.mode``).
Mirrors packages.domain.journey_manifest.yaml's enums.production_modes -- validated
here too so an out-of-range value 422s at the API boundary (AT-PRJ-003.1), not just
silently falls through the journey engine's applicability resolver.

ProjectScale.title: ProjectScale
ProjectScale.description: Project scale (D1, TFD-PRJ-001). Same provisional status as QualityProfile.

ProjectUpdateRequest.title: ProjectUpdateRequest
ProjectUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /projects/{id} (TFD-PRJ-002/003). Every field is optional; only fields
actually present are changed (``exclude_unset`` at the service boundary), so
omitting a field is not the same as explicitly clearing it.

QualityProfile.title: QualityProfile
QualityProfile.description:
Visual quality profile (D1, TFD-PRJ-001). PRD §8 names the field but not its
values (DEC-028: per-format defaults are open); this is a provisional 3-tier
placeholder pending production validation, not a specified product requirement.
